reason: I'd take the free first visit, and if my toddler likes it I'd pay the $14 drop-in once because the coffee is included and I could get a little work done. We'd only go once or twice a month, so I'd never do a membership.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership, and $14 a visit adds up fast on my budget when the library story time is free.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $10 for one child, or a pack of visits that doesn't expire so I can use it slowly.
